name: EPIC 212227906
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 16, 9.8 solar radii and 0.87 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,464 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 16, give 0.87 solar masses and 9.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,820 K at its surface.
